cli.intro: pandark — crawl and extraction orchestrator for notedown-ir::DocumentGraph
cli.cmd.plan: Build a crawl plan without network I/O
cli.cmd.fetch: Fetch one URL or local path into a FetchArtifact
cli.cmd.crawl: Crawl linked HTML pages through the transport implied by the seed
cli.cmd.extract: Extract notedown-ir from a local HTML file
cli.cmd.inspect: Probe extractors, links, or extract plan without writing IR
cli.cmd.doctor: Check CLI install, native bindings, and environment
cli.opt.stage: Inspect stage: probe, links, or extract-plan
cli.opt.from: Input format: html, snapshot, or auto
cli.opt.challengePolicy: Challenge policy: stop, pause-for-operator, skip-page, fallback-http
cli.opt.report: Write JSON report to a file
